data.title: bn-15zfa: run-config bounds for Nat/Int and bounded scalar state lowering (RFC 0003 corr. 4 part A)

data.body: [risk:high][informational] Five-question review. 1) Failure modes: malformed, inverted, or oversized ranges; configuration integers outside their type bound; empty bound/refinement intersections; missing bounds; combinatorial initialization; identity omission; and updates leaving the domain. These paths fail closed through config.rs:566-619 and lower.rs:781-866, 912-1004, 1422-1498. 2) Edge cases: absent and empty bounds, Nat zero and 65535, Int singleton and both i64 edges, nested constants, empty intersections, equivalent serialization, and legacy identity preservation. Tests cover these at tests/bounds.rs:75-223, 250-439 and tests/resource_bounds.rs:1538-1668. 3) Rollback: revert before bounded artifacts publish. After publication, preserve the reader and schema, then use an explicit compatibility migration. Never reinterpret an existing content identity. 4) Monitoring: count cml.config.bound_too_large, cml.config.outside_bound, cml.lower.unbounded_type, cml.lower.empty_refinement, budget refusals, and UpdateOutOfDomain. Alert on schema parity or identity drift. 5) Input validation: keep closed JSON objects, strict i64 integers, Nat 0..65535, Int min <= max with at most 65536 values, recursive constant type and bound checks, and typed budget/unbounded refusals. Static validation covered all 11 changed files and git diff --check. Dynamic parity regeneration was unavailable because jsonschema is absent in this reviewer environment. No security finding requires action. Seal approval does not satisfy the separate risk:critical human gate.
